verdict.rationale: Ramp's own product pages say its AI agents "scan transactions in real-time for anomalies," handle "fraud prevention," enforce policy, and "flag anything unclear or risky immediately for your review," escalating when approval is not safe. Together these cover automatic flagging of both anomalous and out-of-policy spend for human review. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how policy and anomaly rules are configured and how the review queue works, plus independent or hands-on corroboration that the flagging works in practice.
